TB retains positive pot disease control,70.97%biocontrol efficacy and growth traits. No in-vivo single-member arms identify necessity or synergy. Relative DNA profiles are not viable-strain persistence; network robustness used simulated removal. Soil metabolites are not directly sampled root exudates,QS/volatiles remain hypotheses,and metabolite validation from the separate six-strain paper is not transferred.

DT retains43.3%barley disease-assay fluorescence reduction,selective pre-challenge measured RNA changes and broad-profile nulls. No significant inoculant pairwise differences or assigned JA/ET/SA pathway dependence. Similarity-based annotations do not identify inoculant transcripts;99%OTU matching does not establish unique viable strains. Prior1070and dated BioProject discussion preserved; access status not rechecked.

Straw retains both process directions and39.85/36.99/19.21%polymer degradation and801.16mL/gTS total biogas. Crude enzymes rather than living producers mediate pretreatment; no reciprocal-fitness evidence or four-isolate methanogenesis inferred. Removed methane annotation does not assert that methane was absent.

SASW retains positive combined BCC outcomes with coating matrix distinct from SynCom-only effects. EPS mediation remains HYPOTHESIZED/PARTIAL; relative16S profiles,100%ASV matching,PICRUSt2 and Mantel/RDA do not establish viable-strain identity,priority-effect causality,BCAA transfer or keystone necessity. Prior1016/1017 removals and S1/S2 knowledge gap preserved.
